CDD.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID=#{depositDeductionHdId}

SELECT nvl(SUM(CDD.DEDUCTION_AMOUNT),0) DEDUCTION_AMOUNT_SUM FROM CSH_DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION CDD JOIN CSH_DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD CDDH ON CDD.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID=CDDH.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID WHERE CDD.TRANSACTION_ID=#{transactionId} AND CDDH.DEPOSIT_STATUS IN ('NEW','APPROVED_RETURN','APPROVING','REJECTED')
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(1) NUM, CDD.CASHFLOW_ID FROM CSH_DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION CDD WHERE CDD.DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION_HD_ID=#{depositDeductionHdId} GROUP BY CDD.CASHFLOW_ID HAVING COUNT(1)>1 )
